description: Application to vary the wording of Conditions 4 and 5 of planning permission P/2005/2500 to enable erection of rear roof extension with front roof windows and front porch extension under permitted development rights
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved as part of planning application P/2006/2056 in relation to the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the buildings hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 1243/1a. Received: 16/08/2005. 1243/2. Received: 05/10/2005. Unnumbered Location Plan, 21CHR-001/1, 21CHR-001/2, 21CHR-001/5 Received: 09/05/2026.

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site, other than under the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B, C and D, shall be carried out. 

Reason:  To protect neighbours' living conditions and the character and appearance of the area and to prevent over-intensive use of the site. 
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows at ground and first floor level shall be constructed.

Reason: In order to protect the appearance of the area and neighbours' living conditions.
Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8 am to 6 pm on Mondays to Friday and 8 am to 12 pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority. 

Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties. 
Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved as part of planning application P/2006/2057 and P/2006/3076 in relation to the noise protection and noise abatement measures of the buildings hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living and working conditions, in accordance with Local Plan policies CC2 and EQ5 and London Plan policies D13 and D14.
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved as part of planning application P/2006/2059 in relation to the hard and soft landscaping to be used in the front and rear gardens and amenity spaces of the buildings hereby permitted.

Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area.
Condition : 9 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. 1243/1a shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles. 

Reason:  in the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety.
Condition : 10 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved as part of planning application P/2006/2121 in relation to the site contamination of the land in which the buildings hereby permitted were built on.

Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. The LPA therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety.
